messages:
sara (Finance): Cobalt AI flagged invoice INV-4220 — says the Q1 pilot promo (20% pilot-discount) wasn't applied to their committed reserved hours. Can billing confirm?

tom-csm: Customer is upset, sent to AE. They expected the promo to be applied across committed pool for Jan-Feb. Need quick reconciliation and a proposed credit.

devin-billing: Looking into invoice mapping. Initial glance shows a promo_code mismatch on the invoice line items. Pulling usage and promo mapping now.

nina-eng: From pricing side we did a mapping change during the pricing-experiment rollout (2026-02-15) that renamed promo tag pilot-discount -> pilot-discount-v2. If invoice generation used old tag, it might miss credit.

pricing-analytics: Querying the billing table: ```SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) as billed, sum(case when promo_applied then discount_amount else 0 end) as discounts FROM invoice_lines WHERE invoice_id='INV-4220' GROUP BY invoice_id;```

billing-bot: Billing export for INV-4220 completed. CSV: /secure/exports/INV-4220-lines.csv

devin-billing: CSV shows billed = $17,250, discounts = $0. Expected 20% on committed lines (~$15,000 committed = $3,000). Looks like promo wasn't applied to committed pool.

pricing-analytics: Cross-checking historical promo mapping: ```SELECT promo_code, start_date, end_date FROM promos WHERE promo_code LIKE 'pilot-discount%';``` Returned pilot-discount (active 2026-01-01 to 2026-02-28) and pilot-discount-v2 (active from 2026-02-15). Edge case where generation used tag resolution that prefers exact code.

nina-eng: Root cause: during the experiment we deployed a migration that created pilot-discount-v2 and deprecated the old alias, but invoice renderer was updated later on 2026-03-05. So invoices generated between 2026-02-15 and 2026-03-05 could miss the legacy promo.

devin-billing: Calculation: committed lines sum = $15,000 -> expected promo = $3,000. Additionally, auto-scaling overage mistakenly billed without committed offset = $450. Recommend refund $3,450 plus a $500 goodwill credit due to AE escalation.

sara (Finance): Proposed total credit = $3,950. Need approvals and ledger entries. Also want standardized customer note for transparency.

tom-csm: Draft message to customer: "We traced a promo mapping issue during a pricing experiment that caused the 20% pilot discount to be omitted from invoice INV-4220. We've issued a $3,950 credit (refund + goodwill). We've fixed the mapping and added a safeguard to invoice generation." Will send after finance approval.

billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-1145 (promo-mapping-missed-credit). Attach: /secure/exports/INV-4220-lines.csv

sara (Finance): Approving manual credit of $3,950. @billing-bot create credit memo and post journal.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-801 created for $3,950. Journal entry JE-2026-03-INV4220 posted. Routing notification sent to Accounting.

devin-billing: I'll add a recovery action in the billing runbook to check promo aliases during rollout windows.

pricing-analytics: I'll flag all invoices generated 2026-02-15..2026-03-05 for the promo alias gap and surface any other affected accounts.

sara (Finance): Thanks all. @tom-csm please coordinate customer communication and confirm when sent so we can close FIN-1145. :white_check_mark:
